Mr. Esquibel moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $212,700.00, seconded by Mr.
Moody. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Jason Sanchez. Community Recreation & Events Director, provided a staff report and committee
members Esquibel and Royba) commented on the item.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Finance Committee, the meeting
was adjourned at 12:10 p.m.
